Poor sleep quality: While alcohol can make you feel sleepy, it disrupts normal sleep stages and lowers sleep quality rather than providing restorative rest. Timing matters: Do not take ZzzQuil after drinking alcohol to help you fall asleep. Because diphenhydramine can linger for hours (with an adult half-life around 9 hours), wait until the medication has cleared and you feel fully alert before drinking alcohol.
